description: This file defines a React functional component named GuardrailTestPanel, which provides a UI for testing guardrails with user input. It includes input handling, copy to clipboard functionality, and displays test results and errors.

methods.name: handleSubmit
methods.description: Handles submission of user input for testing guardrails, including validation and invoking callback.

methods.name: handleKeyDown
methods.description: Handles key down events in the textarea, triggering submit on Enter key press without modifiers.

methods.name: copyToClipboard
methods.description: Copies the provided text to the clipboard, using secure method or fallback.

methods.name: handleCopyInput
methods.description: Handles copying the input text to clipboard and shows success or error notification.
